boundary: This closes shared primary/secondary training allocation semantics in addition to primary-action catalog reachability and numeric growth. Individual passive consumer semantics remain separately evidence-gated.

external_corroboration.claim: Each character level grants one training point; one point raises one technique; most techniques have a maximum level of three.
external_corroboration.evidence_scope: The ROM proves point decrement and slot-state increment. The public guide supplies the level-three cap and the player-facing training-point description.

implementation_contract: Persist all 15 primary and 24 secondary slot states per character.
Do not turn a level threshold directly into a battle-usable action.
Only states 1..254 may enter the battle action catalog.
Spend one training point to raise a trainable primary action by one level, capped at three.
Spend one training point to raise a trainable secondary passive by one level, capped at three.
Materialize action numeric growth from the persisted action level before browser validation and resolution.
Scenario enemies without player progression use runtime states derived from their immutable character definition.

transitions.template_initialization: Copy each four-byte slot; when state is 0xFF and unlock_level is nonzero and <= character level, materialize runtime state 0.
transitions.training_point_write: 0x08093160 decrements template +0xBA once; row type 4 increments template +0x51+slot*4, all other trainable rows increment template +0x15+slot*4.
